headline: Bunge Closes Chemical Plant in Argentina, Resulting in 110 Layoffs
summary: Agribusiness giant Bunge shut down a chemical production plant in Campana, Argentina, that manufactured inputs for fertilizers, cutting 110 jobs due to infrastructure limitations and market changes.
why: Bunge is a major global agribusiness and food ingredient company, and facility closures reflect regional pressures on input manufacturing and agricultural supply chains.

impacts.name: Bunge Global SA
impacts.why: Shuttering a specialized manufacturing plant alters regional supply capacity for agricultural chemical inputs.
